meta.name: remove-ai-slops
meta.description: Removes AI-generated code smells from branch changes or an explicit file list behind regression tests. Use when the user asks to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 清理代码中AI生成的坏味道与冗余痕迹
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常担心AI助手留下的代码不够干净
copy.tagline_en: Clean up AI-generated code smells and redundant patterns in your recent changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often worry about messy code left by AI assistants

howto.what: 它会先写回归测试锁住现有行为，再按九类 AI 味代码逐项清理你的改动文件，最后跑测试、lint、类型检查验收；验证不通过就回退或直接改。
howto.when: 当你要求清理、去 AI 味或 deslop 最近的改动，或指定一批文件时触发；默认范围是分支相对 merge-base main 的 diff。

say.text: 帮我清理一下当前分支最近的改动
say.note: 先跑回归测试锁行为，再分批清理并验收

say.text: 把 src/foo.py 和 src/bar.py 去一下 AI 味
say.note: 以指定文件列表为清理范围

say.text: 只删死代码和多余注释，别动公共接口

howto.what_en: It first writes regression tests to lock current behavior, then clears nine categories of AI slop from your changed files in batches, then verifies with tests, lint, and typecheck; reverts or edits directly if verification fails.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes, or pass an explicit file list; default scope is the branch diff against merge-base main.

say_en.text: Clean up the AI slop in my branch's recent changes
say_en.note: Locks behavior with tests, then cleans in batches
Uses the given file list as the scope

say_en.text: Only remove dead code and obvious comments, keep the public API
